assessments.reasoning: Section 2.28.4 says that a package specification precedes the associated body and importing units, and that compilation of the specification invalidates those units, requiring recompilation. The paragraph distinguishes source files from compilation units. The next paragraph and Figure 8 explain reciprocal imports between two bodies after their specifications.

limitations: The compilation ordering applies to units. The report permits multiple units per source file. Its mutually dependent example concerns the bodies after both specifications are compiled.
